definition.purpose: Generate QQQ notification-only plans from SPXW capital-type GEX data, using NQMain percentage path as the historical 03:30 proxy.
definition.rationale: Combines price/PCR quadrant base signals with sell-call level and sell-put share for Yellow quality, and uses prior-five-session NQ regime for Green timing.
definition.base_signal_rule: BULLISH iff CloseChangePct < 0 and PCRChangePct < -5.0; BEARISH iff CloseChangePct > 0 and PCRChangePct > 5.0; otherwise NONE.

source_refresh_gate.query_identity: SELECT ObservationDate, ASXCode, GEXDelta, CapitalType, Close, VWAP, NoOfOption, GEX FROM StockDB_US.Transform.OptionGEXChangeCapitalType WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ASXCode='SPXW.US' ORDER BY ObservationDate, CapitalType
source_refresh_gate.expected_completed_session: On an XNYS action date D1, expected D0 = previous XNYS cash session.
component_checks: Exactly one BC, one BP, one SC and one SP row for D0.
No duplicate CapitalType row for D0.
Close values across BC/BP/SC/SP must be identical to 1e-9.
Previous XNYS session must also have exactly BC/BP/SC/SP before any percent-change rule is evaluated.
source_refresh_gate.refresh_marker: Canonical D0 row hash must be identical on two consecutive 2-minute heartbeats, second heartbeat no later than 03:28:00 America/New_York; hash = SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON sorted by CapitalType containing ObservationDate,ASXCode,CapitalType,GEXDelta,GEX,Close,VWAP,NoOfOption.
source_refresh_gate.open_interest_or_revision_marker: OPEN_INTEREST_NOT_APPLICABLE: this strategy consumes GEX/GEXDelta capital-type rows and does not use an open-interest field. The canonical four-row SHA-256 is the revision marker.
source_refresh_gate.timezone_normalization: ObservationDate is interpreted as XNYS market date. Scheduler and timestamps use IANA America/New_York; UI/runtime display may additionally use Australia/Sydney.
source_refresh_gate.stale_data_threshold: If D0 != previous XNYS session or stable second heartbeat occurs after 03:28:00, readiness fails for that action date.
source_refresh_gate.missing_or_partial: Return NOT_READY. Create no Observation, Signal, report, paper plan or notification.
source_refresh_gate.revised_data: Any byte-level change to canonical D0 component values changes source_revision. Re-run evaluation. Preserve prior immutable report and mark it superseded. Recompute any non-final outcome; finalized outcomes are recomputed only under explicit SOURCE_CORRECTION workflow.
source_refresh_gate.idempotency: For unchanged source_revision and scheduled action date, reuse the existing evaluation/report/signal; do not create duplicates.
source_refresh_gate.not_ready_vs_no_signal: NOT_READY is a runtime readiness status and is not a Signal. NO_SIGNAL is emitted only after readiness passes and rule evaluation finds no signal.

TotalAbsGEXDelta.null: DATA_ERROR if any component null or total <= 0

CausalQuantile60.formula: For any named feature X, threshold Pq uses only the 60 prior valid XNYS observations, current D0 excluded. Sort the 60 prior valid values ascending. Use linear quantile (Hyndman-Fan type 7): h=(60-1)*0.5; j=floor(h); g=h-j; threshold=x[j]+g*(x[j+1]-x[j]). Current observation is excluded.
CausalQuantile60.null: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY until 60 prior valid values exist
CausalQuantile60.tie_behavior: Signal predicates use the written <=, <, >= or > exactly; no epsilon and no pre-rounding.
CausalQuantile60.late_corrected: New canonical source hash creates a new revision and reevaluation.
CausalQuantile60.future_information_proof: Every rolling input is filtered ObservationDate < D0 before tail(60); D1/D2 prices are outcome-only and never used in D0 trigger calculation.

SC_GEX_Median60.formula: median of exactly 60 prior valid SC GEX levels; current excluded; linear P50 equals median for 60 sorted values
SC_GEX_Median60.tie_behavior: SC_LOW is true when current <= threshold.

Prior5D_NQ_Return.formula: NQ cash-session D0 close / NQ cash-session close five XNYS sessions before D0 - 1
Prior5D_NQ_Return.null: DATA_ERROR / NOT_READY for trading if source unavailable
Prior5D_NQ_Return.future_information_proof: Uses D0 and earlier closes only.

rules: While PENDING_GREEN_DIP, LONG_GREEN or SHORT_YELLOW, all newly evaluated actionable signals are recorded but trade_allowed=false and skip_reason=EXISTING_POSITION_PRIORITY.
No stacking, leverage increase, opposite override or Green D5 clock refresh.

signal_definitions.definition: BEARISH base signal plus low SC GEX level and high sell-put delta share.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal==BEARISH AND SC_GEX_Level <= SC_GEX_Median60 AND SPShare > P75_SPShare_60
signal_definitions.entry_policy: SHORT QQQ D1 at 03:30 America/New_York. Live reference is QQQ executable price; historical model uses NQMain D1 03:30 Open as percentage-path proxy.
exit_conditions: TP: entry*0.992; for short, Low <= TP.
SL: entry*1.010; for short, High >= SL.
If bar Open is beyond TP or SL, fill at Open.
If TP and SL both touched in same 30m bar, assume SL first and mark ambiguous=true.
No scheduled time exit in v1.0.2; position remains until TP or SL unless cancelled before entry.
No opposing-signal exit after position opens; existing-position priority blocks new signals.

future_outcome.bar_frequency: 30 minutes or finer; the supplied historical contract uses 30-minute bars.
future_outcome.reference_entry_price: D1/D3 03:30 NQMain bar Open or Green dip logic

exit_price_rules.Yellow: TP/SL first touch with no scheduled exit

future_outcome.pending_rule: Outcome remains PENDING until entry bar and every bar needed to prove an earlier terminal condition through the scheduled terminal bar exist. Missing required bars do not imply no hit.
future_outcome.market_closed: Remain PENDING until the next required XNYS/futures data is published; never synthesize a price.
future_outcome.missing_bar: PENDING plus MISSING_REQUIRED_BAR audit flag; do not forward-fill OHLC.
future_outcome.correction: Every market-bar snapshot has a revision hash. If finalized source bars change under explicit SOURCE_CORRECTION, calculate a new outcome revision, preserve the old finalized record as superseded, and link both revisions.
future_outcome.gap_rule: If an active stop/limit is already crossed by a bar Open, fill at Open; otherwise fill at the specified level when High/Low touches it. Time exits use terminal bar Close.
future_outcome.opposing_signal: Does not change an already-triggered production outcome unless the signal definition explicitly has an opposing-signal exit. These versions do not, except SPX portfolio admission prevents overlapping plans before entry.
future_outcome.return_formula: LONG gross=(exit/entry-1)*100. SHORT gross=(entry-exit)/entry*100. Net return = gross return - modeled round-trip slippage/cost percentage points.
future_outcome.costs_slippage: Referenced v1.0.2 historical backtest modeled no slippage/cost; future paper outcome cost model is NOT_AVAILABLE pending review.
future_outcome.direction_convention: Positive return_pct is profitable in the signal direction.
future_outcome.manual_independence: Outcome worker MUST NOT read TradePlan.ActualEntry, ActualExit, ActualQuantity or broker/manual trade records.
future_outcome.idempotency: Key = strategy/version/market_date/signal_code/source_revision/calculation_version. Repeated runs reuse the same PENDING/FINAL record.

production_policy.recipient: STRATEGY_OWNER logical recipient; deployment resolves PUSHOVER_USER_KEY from secret storage, never from strategy files.
production_policy.report_link_format: runtime_authenticated_origin + "/strategy-reports/" + immutable_public_report_id; authentication flow must preserve this return path. No auth token is embedded in the URL.
production_policy.retry_policy: Transactional outbox. Retry explicit HTTP non-2xx at +30s, +2m and +5m. On network timeout/unknown acknowledgement, do NOT blind-retry; mark DELIVERY_UNKNOWN for operator reconciliation to avoid duplicate pushes.
production_policy.enablement_change_control: Enablement is deployment/version-specific. Any logic/source/exit change creates a new version; enabling push requires human approval and audit event DEPLOYMENT_CHANGED.
production_policy.notification_body_format: Market date={market_date}; signal={signal_code}; confidence={confidence_label}; planned entry={entry_policy}; exit={exit_summary}; source revision={source_revision}; report={report_link}. No broker order is submitted.
production_policy.secrets: PUSHOVER_USER_KEY and PUSHOVER_API_TOKEN exist only in secret storage; never reports, notifications, JSON or logs.

report.immutable_public_report_id: UUIDv7 generated once after evaluation; report body is immutable. Corrections create a new report ID that references superseded_report_id.

reports_and_audit.audit_security: Never include passwords, API keys, Pushover tokens, connection strings, or authentication cookies.

out_of_sample_window.reason: Prior results are a historical research/backtest reference, not an untouched OOS study.
